name: Pallid Dove
rangeDescription: Tropical lowlands of western colombia and western ecuador
description: A rather plain medium-sized dove, mostly restricted to western Ecuador but also occurs in western Colombia and extreme northwestern Peru. Within range, the main confusion species is White-tipped Dove.

name: Great Swallow-tailed Swift
rangeDescription: Mountains of southern mexico to southern honduras and (rarely) northern costa rica
description: Large, spectacular swift, seen singly or in small groups (up to 10 birds). Favors drier mountain and foothill areas, often near cliffs, but ranges widely.

name: Ortolan Bunting
rangeDescription: Western palearctic; winters mediterranean environs, arabia, and africa
description: Fairly small bunting. Males are striking with a green-gray head and yellow mustache, eyering, and throat contrasting with a chestnut belly and intricately marked upperparts.

name: Striped Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Mountains of northeastern india (assam) and southwestern myanmar (chin hills)
description: A slender brown bird with fine white streaks prominently visible on the upperparts. Note the white eyebrow and the white cheeks.

name: Bare-faced Bulbul
rangeDescription: Limestone karst of central laos; perhaps also west-central vietnam
description: Sickly-looking, greenish-brown bulbul with a naked pink head. Endemic to Laos, where it is found solely in limestone karst forest; favors areas with bushy cover.

name: Chusquea Tapaculo
rangeDescription: Andes of southern ecuador to far northern peru (eastern piura and northern cajamarca)
description: Drab, mouse-like bird found in high-elevation cloud forest along the east slope of the Andes in southern Ecuador and far northern Peru. Plumage is gray with brown on lower back, wings, vent, and tail.

name: Yellow-crowned Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Southwestern costa rica to northern bolivia, the guianas, and amazonian brazil
description: Small, small-billed flycatcher usually found in the canopy. Yellow belly with gray head and pale whitish eyebrow.

name: Masked Finfoot
rangeDescription: Bangladesh and northeastern india to indochina; winters to sumatra
description: A bizarre bird that loosely resembles a cormorant with a hornbill’s brightly-colored beak. Gray-brown overall with a black mask extending from the face down to the throat that is darker and more extensive in males.

name: Seychelles Parrot
rangeDescription: Seychelles (praslin and curieuse)
description: Fairly large, long-tailed dark gray parrot. Found locally in the granitic Seychelles, mainly on the island of Praslin.

name: Maui Alauahio
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of eastern maui
description: A small Hawaiian honeycreeper of native forests above 5,000 feet elevation on eastern Maui. Occurs in non-native forest at Poli-Poli.

name: Tricolored Parrotfinch
rangeDescription: Lesser sundas (timor, wetar, babar, damar, romang, and tanimbar)
description: A small blue finch with conspicuous red tail and an emerald-green back. Females duller, with green extending to nape.

name: Bulwer's Petrel
rangeDescription: Azores to cape verde, johnston, and northwestern hawaiian islands
description: A small, slender petrel with long, narrow wings and a long tail. It is entirely dark brown except for diagonal buff-colored bars on the upper wings.

name: Rüppell's Warbler
rangeDescription: Rocky slopes of eastern mediterranean region; winters in northeastern africa
description: Fairly large Curruca warbler. Male is distinctive with a black bib and blackish head separated by prominent white moustache.

name: Blue-fronted Lorikeet
rangeDescription: Buru (southern moluccas)
description: A small, bright green parrot with a short pointed tail, confined to the island of Buru. Note the orange bill and legs and the subtle blue patch on the rear crown, which is brighter in males.

name: Carunculated Fruit-Dove
rangeDescription: Obi (north-central moluccas)
description: A unique small, colorful fruit-dove confined to Obi island. Pale gray head contrasts with mostly emerald-green body, except for gray markings on the wings and back, a deep maroon belly patch, and a lemon-yellow vent and undertail.

name: Baikal Teal
rangeDescription: Breeds in northern and eastern siberia; winters japan, korea, and eastern china
description: Males is exquisitely patterned, with an unmistakable green-and-yellow facial pattern, spotted rose-pink breast, and long, drooping scapulars. Female mostly drab brown but with a distinct white spot near the bill base as well as a very weak hint of the male's facial pattern.

name: Malaita Owl
rangeDescription: Malaita (central solomon islands)
description: A rather small dark brown owl with black eyes, a white throat, and white eyebrows. Underparts are densely barred.

name: Growling Riflebird
rangeDescription: Lowlands of central and southeastern papua new guinea
description: A large bird of lowland and foothill forest in eastern New Guinea. The bill is fairly long, slightly curved and more feathered in the base than its sister species.

name: Tboli Sunbird
rangeDescription: Southern philippines (mountains of southern mindanao)
description: A small, localized bird of montane forest in southern Mindanao. Has a long, curved bill, a gray head, yellow underparts and rump, an olive back and wings, and a white-tipped tail.

name: Alagoas Antwren
rangeDescription: Northeastern brazil (alagoas near murici on rio pedra branca)
description: Very rare antwren, unmistakable in its tiny range, likely now restricted to one complex of humid forest fragments in the Brazilian state of Alagoas. Males are gray with a blackish throat and females are cinnamon-colored.
